testcase.name: Scenario: Move an unavailable command to an expanded panel and back: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:340:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move an unavailable command to an expanded panel and back ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon shows an unavailable Copy command in the Clipboard main panel ✔ When the user right-clicks Copy and selects "Move to Expanded Panel" ✔ Then Copy is no longer visible in the Clipboard main panel ✔ And the Clipboard panel has an expansion arrow ✔ When the user opens the Clipboard expanded panel ✔ Then Copy appears there as an unavailable command ✔ When the user clicks Copy in the expanded panel ✔ Then the expanded panel remains open and no command opens ✔ When the user right-clicks Copy in the expanded panel ✔ Then the context menu offers "Move to Main Panel" and "Add to Quick Access Toolbar" ✔ When the user selects "Move to Main Panel" ✔ Then the expansion closes ✔ And the unavailable Copy command appears in the Clipboard main panel again ✔ And the part remains visible
